lines.zh: 工具袋挂在腰上，走一步响一下
lines.en: My tool bag clinks with every step.
I always watch the ground as I walk.
My goggles rest up on my forehead.
My soles are caked with oil and filings.

lines.zh: 绕过自己的作品，别踩坏
lines.en: I step around my own work; don't crush it.
I walk from the workshop to the village gate.
This hammer isn't light.

lines.zh: 我走路时在算引信长度
lines.en: I'm counting fuse length as I walk.

lines.zh: 地上的零件我一个也不踩
lines.en: I don't step on a single part on the floor.

lines.zh: 他们都在前面，我在后面
lines.en: They're all up front; I stay behind.
Slow down or the blueprint falls.
I peek around corners first.
I smell of sulfur.

lines.zh: 走过的地方留一串小脚印
lines.en: A line of small prints follows me.
Don't block me, I'm in a hurry.

lines.zh: 这群哥布林，只有我在干活
lines.en: Of all these goblins, only I do the work.
I spread the blueprint on my knee.
My fingers are oily and the pages turn slowly.

lines.zh: 我在给一个小东西上弦
lines.en: I'm winding up a small thing.
There's a crack in my goggles.

lines.zh: 这批玩具的引信短了半寸
lines.en: This batch's fuses are half an inch short.

lines.zh: 我咬着笔杆，想一个新做法
lines.en: I chew the pen, thinking of a new way.
My hammer lies at my feet.
The workshop smells of rust.
I don't like going to the front myself.
This one came out well; I'll keep it.
Someone's at the door; I don't care.
Don't touch the things on the shelf.
The toys by my feet are twitching.
I'm counting how much powder is left.
Too noisy outside; I shut the door.
This work needs patience.
You're not a goblin.
Your hands have no grease on them.

lines.zh: 看什么，没见过女工程师
lines.en: What? Never seen a female engineer.
Don't touch that; it'll blow.

lines.zh: 我身上没有值钱的东西
lines.en: I've nothing valuable on me.
That blade at your belt is decent.
You can't read these blueprints.
There's a fuse where you're standing.

lines.zh: 我不会跟你打，我有别的东西
lines.en: I won't fight you; I have other things.
One step more and I blow the whistle.
You're weighing what I'm worth.

lines.zh: 我把工具往身后挪了挪
lines.en: I slide my tools behind me.
My tool bag hit the ground.
My goggles flew off.
I crouch and hold my hand.
Blood on the oil stains.
That broke my calculations.
I back behind the bench.
A corner of the blueprint tore.
I grit my teeth and didn't cry out.
My hand is still feeling for the wrench.
With this, I can still work.
Gold? I prefer parts.

lines.zh: 你手里那块铁，看着不错
lines.en: That iron in your hand looks decent.
Gears, I want gears.
Put it on the ground and step back.
Not enough for half a toy.
I can smell powder.
Skip the tricks; I won't fall for them.
I've nothing to give in return.
Keep it for yourself.
This size doesn't fit.
Bring more and I'll consider.
Take that powder bag farther off.

lines.zh: 我需要的是引信，不是钱
lines.en: What I need is fuse, not coin.
These parts are only so-so.
Bring a full set and I'll trade.
Don't bump my tool bag.
One bump and parts fell out.
I crouch to gather them; step aside.
You're taller, and I'm not afraid.
Stand back, the oil will rub off.
That crumpled the blueprint.
I retreat behind the workbench.
You touched my goggles.

lines.zh: 让一让，我手里拿着东西
lines.en: Let me by, my hands are full.
My work's on the floor; don't step.
Why are you asking that?
The workshop matters more.
Plenty of goblins in this village.
I have work to do.
That's not your concern.
My hands are covered in oil.
My children are these toys.
If you want to buy something, say so.
Ask and then leave.
This iron's still usable.
Screws, pick them up.
I bend quickly and gather quickly.
Whatever falls is mine.
This nail's bent, worthless.
Parts mustn't be wasted.
I stuff them into the bag.
This one fills the gap.

lines.zh: 我捡东西时还要看着别处
lines.en: I gather while watching elsewhere.
Not one goes to outsiders.
Someone's approaching the workshop.
First, let me see who it is.
This doesn't smell like goblin.
I touch the small thing at my belt.
Position noted.
It's blocking the door.
I send the toy out.
Go that way; there's a fuse there.
I needn't move myself.
Let it test you first.
It's circling over there.
One step closer and it lights.

lines.zh: 我退到图纸后面，按下开关。
lines.en: I step behind the blueprint and hit the switch.
Don't kick it; that makes it faster.
I retreat behind the bench.
The fuse has three breaths left.
Retreating won't help.
I've released the second batch too.
This thing runs faster than you.
It's making that sound.
The little thing pops and everything scatters.

lines.zh: 我的小玩偶扑上去了，看。
lines.en: My little toy is lunging at you — watch.
The powder smell is sharp.
I cover my ears and step back twice.
It lunged on its own.
The ground by you is loose.
Release another, simple.
This batch came out well.
I gesture for it to come back.
It's back, and one is left.

lines.zh: 锤子敲了三下，我站起来
lines.en: Three hammer blows and I stand up.
The workshop door opens.
I push my goggles up.
The pile of parts on the bench has taken shape.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖围裙上的铁屑
lines.en: I shake the filings off my apron.
The work here has just begun.
They're shouting outside; I hear it.
I pick up the nearest tool.
I'll watch this batch myself.
The things at my feet have started moving.

lines.zh: 火药先着了，我的袖子也着了
lines.en: The powder caught first, then my sleeve.

lines.zh: 摔下去，膝盖磕在工作台上
lines.en: I fell, knee striking the bench.
Soaked, the whole blueprint is ruined.

lines.zh: 我自己的配方炸了我一手
lines.en: My own mix blew up in my hand.
An arrow stuck in my tool bag.

lines.zh: 法术打来，我的护目镜亮了
lines.en: The spell hit and my goggles glowed.

lines.zh: 忙了三天，没吃什么东西
lines.en: Three days busy, next to nothing eaten.
Lightning struck and all the iron went live.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有台子，我抓不住东西
lines.en: No bench in the void; nothing to grab.
